originalFinding.freeCheck: [fx-nyc-high-20261118] GAP-NYC-SETTLE: free official-source check (Contract terms PDF: Weather_Terms_and_Conditions_67323dd4-5775-48d5-bea0-c33d672d1f74.pdf, NWS Climatological Report (Daily) for Central Park, product CLINYC) -> inconclusive. Rule 13.111(i)(2) settles on the first published version that confirms the value, so later revisions and corrections do not count. But the rule text is missing a word after 'confirmation of the', and NWS publishes a same-day CLINYC before the full-day one (Nov 17: issued 4:38 PM EST, valid as of 4:00 PM, max 57F at 3:55 PM). The terms do not say whether that partial-day report counts as the first published version, so the gap stays open.

proposal.rationale: Which issuance of the NWS Central Park daily climate report (preliminary, final, or a later correction) does Gemini use to settle? If a correction moves the max across a 2°F band edge, the version used decides the outcome. No cached or free official source answered it, and catalog item 'NWS daily climate report: settlement-version check (Circle Gateway nanopayment)' answers exactly this gap type.
